### Pathway enrichment GSEA {.tabset}
```{r results = 'asis' ,echo = FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
# Define the cell line and drug to use in this comparison by using the info in comparisons

Cell_line = comparisons$cell_line[which(comparisons$namecontrast == name)]

Drug = comparisons$drug[which(comparisons$namecontrast == name)]

cat('\n')
cat("####", "Hallmark {.tabset}")
cat('\n')

gene_expression_fold = all_contrasts[[name]]$log2FC
names(gene_expression_fold) = all_contrasts[[name]]$symbol

res_hall <- gsea_results_logpval_prot(res_tib = all_contrasts[[name]], 
                                 geneset = Hallmark, 
                                 name, 
                                 Chemo_path = params$Chemo_path, 
                                 Cellline = Cell_line , 
                                 Celline_Dict_Chemo_path = params$Cell_Dict_path, 
                                 drug = Drug, 
                                 Organism = params$Organism
                                 )



cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Pathway visualization")
cat('\n')
filename <- paste("Hallmark", "Whole_Vis", name,'.html', sep = '_')
filepath <- file.path(saveDir,"contrasts",name, "gsea_res", "Hallmark", filename )

CompleteVisualPathwaysGsea_V2(res_hall$gsea_table, filepath)
cat('\n')



cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Signficant pathways GeneRatios")
cat('\n')
if(nrow(res_hall$gseares@result)>0 ){
dotplot(res_hall$gseares)
}else{
 cat("No significant pathways")   
    
}    
cat('\n')

# filename <- paste("Hallmark", "Dotplot", name,'.jpeg', sep = '_')
# filepath <- file.path(saveDir,"contrasts",name, "gsea_res", "Hallmark", filename )
# dotplot(res_hall$gseares)

# dotplot(res_hall$gseares)
# dev.off()
# cat('\n')




cat('\n')
cat("#####", " Top pathways vs NES")
cat('\n')
filename <- paste("Hallmark", "DotplotV2", name,'.jpeg', sep = '_')
filepath <- file.path(saveDir,"contrasts",name, "gsea_res", "Hallmark", filename )

VisualPathways(res_hall$gsea_table, filepath)
cat('\n')






cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Genes within pathways")
cat('\n')
cnetplot(res_hall$gseares, cex_label_gene=0.3, cex_label_category = 0.5, showCategory = 8, foldChange = gene_expression_fold) + scale_color_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0,                    # Neutral point corresponds to no change
    low = "blue", high = "red",      # Low values (downregulated) are blue, high are red
    mid = "white",
    
  )
cat('\n')


cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Tree: pathway cluster ")
cat('\n')
if(nrow(res_hall$gsea_table) > 5){
sim <- pairwise_termsim(res_hall$gseares)
treeplot(sim, hclust_method = 'average')
}else{
    cat('\n')
    cat("**", paste("Not enough pathways to fit a tree"), "**\n")
    cat('\n')
}
cat('\n')


cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Top upregulated")
cat('\n')

plot_top_gsea(res_hall, top='up')
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Top Downregulated")
cat('\n')

plot_top_gsea(res_hall, top='down')
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Table of enriched pathways")
cat('\n')

downloadableDTExcel(res_hall$gsea_table %>% dplyr::select(ID, pathway,pval, padj, ES, NES, size, core_enrichment, link,Target_Chemo_esp, Target_Chemo_all), escape=FALSE) %>% formatSignif(columns = c('pval','padj', 'ES', 'NES'), digits = 3)
cat('\n')
```
